Success criteria

• Form loads fast and works on major browsers and phones without layout issues.

title: Wireless Video & Data Acquisition Prototype

title: Android Algebra Study App
desc:

The app will present each topic—linear equations, quadratic functions, factoring, and so on—in a clean, distraction-free interface and keep track of how far the student has progressed through the material. The progress-tracking dashboard is the must-have feature: after every section the user should instantly see completion percentages and a simple visual indicator showing what still needs review.  

Feel free to suggest elegant ways to store that data locally or in the cloud, yet keep the first version light so it runs smoothly on typical student devices. Although practice quizzes or step-by-step solutions might be interesting future add-ons, you can ignore them for this build and focus your time on a rock-solid reading experience, intuitive navigation, and reliable progress persistence.

Deliverables  
• Full Android Studio project (Kotlin or Java) with well-commented source code  
• Signed APK ready for Play Store submission  
• Brief set-up document explaining how to update content and reset progress data  

Acceptance criteria  
• Topics load instantly, and progress bars update without glitches  
• App installs on Android 7.0 and above with no crashes during a five-minute exploratory test  
• Code passes a quick review for readability and uses standard Android architecture components  

Let me know how you would structure the data model for tracking comp

title: PLC-Controlled Microwave Automation
desc:
I want my microwave to obey the same Start/Stop, cooking-time, and temperature commands that I already issue from my PLC / HMI instead of pressing the front panel keys. The idea is to tap into the oven’s control board (or replace it if that proves cleaner) and expose safe, isolated I/O points the PLC can drive.  

The job covers tracing the existing circuitry, designing a small interface that links the magnetron controls and door interlocks to digital or serial lines, and supplying the PLC logic and an HMI screen so I can trigger a cycle, set the exact seconds, and vary the power level without touching the appliance.

Safety is critical: all native protections, RF shielding, and door-closed interlocks must stay intact. I am currently running a Siemens S7-1200 but can map your code to another platform if that speeds things up.

Deliverables  
• Schematic and wiring diagram for the microwave-to-PLC interface (opto-isolated preferred)  
• Bill of materials and any PCB or breakout design files  
• PLC program plus sample HMI layout handling Start, Stop, Time, and Temperature fields  
• Step-by-step installation and test guide illustrated with photos or clear diagrams  

I will handle the physical wiring on site following your instructions; remote collaboration is fine as long as the documentation is unambiguous.

title: Industrial Control System Electrical Design
desc:
I’m upgrading the control-side of an industrial installation and need a seasoned electrical designer to turn my functional requirements into complete, build-ready documentation. The scope is strictly the control system — power distribution and lighting are handled elsewhere — so the focus will be on I/O allocation, panel layouts, wiring schematics, interlock logic and all the drawings a panel shop and field team need to fabricate, install and commission the system.

Here’s what I expect to walk away with:  
• Detailed single-line and schematic drawings in AutoCAD Electrical or EPLAN (DWG + PDF).  
• Control panel layout, terminal diagrams and cable schedules.  
• Bill of materials with manufacturer part numbers and load calculations.  
• Compliance notes to IEC/NFPA standards that apply to the plant.  
• A concise design brief explaining operational sequences so my PLC programmer can pick it up without guesswork.

If you already work in a different CAD platform, mention it; I can adapt as long as I get editable files. Familiarity with PLC, SCADA and general automation practices is important because I value design decisions that anticipate programming and commissioning.

I can supply the P&IDs, device list and an outline of the required sequences as soon as we start. Let me know your typical turnaround time for the first draft and how you prefer to handle design reviews.

title: Power Automate MS 365 Workflow Optimization
desc:

Scope of work  
• Review our current Microsoft 365 environment, mapping the manual touchpoints that slow us down.  
• Design and build cloud-first Power Automate solutions that automatically sort and route emails in Outlook, move or tag files in SharePoint based on metadata, and update task lists or Planner boards inside Teams without human intervention.  
• Ensure each flow includes clear error-handling and logging so issues surface immediately rather than days later.  
• Provide concise user documentation and a hand-off session so my staff can maintain the flows after delivery.  

Acceptance criteria  
1. All three processes complete without manual steps in 90 % of routine cases.  
2. Processing time per item is cut in half compared with our current baseline.  
3. Flows are published in our tenant, version-controlled, and named uniformly for easy upkeep.  

Power Automate, SharePoint API, adaptive cards for Teams, and, where helpful, Graph connectors are acceptable tools as long as they stay within standard licensing.  

If clarification is needed, I’m available for quick calls or screen-shares; otherwise, I’m ready to see what you can architect.

desc:

Before I move on to character tweaks or pacing, I need an experienced screenwriter to tighten the story logic, with a laser focus on how this specific time-travel mechanism works from scene to scene.

Your job is to examine every beat where the protagonists slip between timelines, make sure the causal rules stay airtight, and flag or rewrite any moment that could confuse viewers. I want the transitions to feel inevitable yet surprising, the stakes crystal-clear, and the paradoxes resolved in a way that audiences can emotionally track without stopping to question the rules.

Deliverables  
• Marked-up script (Final Draft or PDF) showing all recommended changes  
• Clean revised draft ready for table read  
• Brief logic map that outlines the soul-crossing rules and how each jump advances the redemption arc  

I’m looking for someone fluent in K-drama tone who can balance high-concept mechanics with heartfelt resonance. If you’ve already wrangled complex timelines or supernatural devices on screen, I’d love to see how you would elevate mine.

4. Payment flow tested in sandbox mode and demoed via screen-share.

title: Concrete School Structure Design
desc:

The architectural concept is already sketched, so your focus is to translate it into a safe, code-compliant structural system I can hand straight to the local authorities and the contractors.

Please base the solution on reinforced concrete framing—slabs, beams, columns, and foundations—sized for typical classroom, corridor, and assembly loads. Local seismic and wind requirements must be reflected in your calculations.

Deliverables I expect:  
• Full set of structural drawings in DWG and PDF (plans, elevations, sections, details)  
• Design calculations report generated from ETABS / SAP2000 / STAAD Pro (or equivalent) showing load cases, combinations, and member checks  
• Rebar schedules and bar-bending lists  
• General construction notes and material specifications suitable for tender  
• A short summary explaining any assumptions so reviewers can trace your logic

Acceptance will be based on:  
• Conformance with the most recent national building code and the stated concrete materials preference  
• Clear, clash-free drawings ready for printing at A1/A3  
• Calculations that balance safety and economy and can be independently verified without missing data

If you have questions about grid spacing, live loads, or foundation soil parameters, let me know early so we keep momentum. I’m ready to move as soon as we agree on a timeline.

I’ll test a small sample first; once it proves clean I’ll release the first milestone and proceed to the full 50k. Further quantities will follow on the same quality terms. Let’s chat about your source, typical match rates, and expected turnaround so we can move quickly.

- Contact municipalities by phone and/or email when necessary.
- Follow a provided script and process when communicating with municipalities.
- Determine the current status of older citations, including citations that may already be 30+ days old.

Municipalities may include Boston, Cambridge, Somerville, Newton, Revere, Lynn, Framingham, Worcester, Brockton, Milton

title: Academic Lead Generation – Research Writing & Publication Support
